newsitem.title: DUBAI: European cargo forum to meet by early December.
newsitem.headline: European cargo forum to meet by early December.

text.p: The first exploratory meeting of the European Cargo Industry Forum is expected to take place at working group level at end-November or early-December, the secretary-general of the European Air Shippers Council (EASC) Chris Welsh said.

The meeting, to be held in Brussels, has "tremendous support from all players in the European airfreight community," whether they be airlines, freight forwarders, shippers or integrators, he told Reuters.
No formal agenda has yet been set but the meeting is expected to discuss "how to change the dialogue process" between the industry's different groups, he added.

Those taking part are likely to include two to three major forwarders at chief executive level, two or three major airlines, two to three shippers as well as representatives from the integrators, Welsh said.

In a speech delivered earlier Wednesday to the 18th Air Cargo Forum, he said that the EASC intended to convene the Forum "to act as catalyst" for improved relationships and partnerships within the air cargo industry.
It will be used as a process by which common process can be identified and agreed industry-wide "best practices" can be applied, he added. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
